span.span: Real-time dialogue decoding. Max accuracy: 76% (perceived Q) and 61% (produced A); chance levels: 20% and 7% respectively.
Real-time sentence decoding; 25.6% median WER at 15.2 WPM. Post hoc word classification accuracy: 47.1%.
30 active ch/subj — 15–100 trials / syllable — 19 Cons. + 3 Vow.
Demonstrated somatotopic layout of articulators (Larynx-Lips-Jaw-Tongue) and emergence of a phonetic feature hierarchy.
Found local selectivity to phonetic features (manner
place). Demonstrated a distributed acoustic-phonetic representation in STG.
Decoded articulatory kinematics to synthesize high-intelligibility audio. 43%–70% word identification accuracy in listening tests.
78 WPM median speed; 9.1% WER (50-word) and 23.9% WER (1,024-word). Integrated real-time speech synthesis and facial avatar.
; STOI = 0.52. Demonstrated performance gains from multi-patient scaling.
First continuously streaming speech BCI. 47.5–90.9 WPM;
1.0s latency. Utilized 80-ms windowing for near-instantaneous synthesis.

span.span: Re-framed typing as a high-dimensional motor task. Achieved 90 CPM; 94.1% raw character accuracy (
High-performance text decoding. Achieved 62 WPM; 9.1% WER (50-word) and 23.8% WER (125,000-word).
Rapidly calibrating neuroprosthesis. 32 WPM speed; 2.5% WER (50-word) and 9.1% WER (125,000-word). Performance stable over 8 months.
First instantaneous causal voice synthesis. 10ms processing latency; 94.3% mean transcript matching accuracy.
Optimized for real-time efficiency. 20.2% relative WER reduction; 83% fewer parameters and 52% less GPU memory than GRU.
Neural foundation model (BIT) pretrained on 367h of cross-species motor activity. Achieved SOTA end-to-end WER of 10.22%.
Joint training across six participants reduced WER by 51.1% on average relative to single-user models. Few-shot adaptation to a held-out user achieved
SOTA sublexical readout; 14.3% PER. Word decoding: 25.6% WER (direct), 19.4% WER (rescored). Demonstrated temporal chunking via attention maps.

span.class: ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_th ltx_th_row ltx_border_t ltx_colspan ltx_colspan_7

span.span: First non-invasive reconstruction of continuous semantic narratives. Recovers the “gist” of perceived/imagined speech and silent videos.
Zero-shot decoding via wav2vec 2.0 alignment. Achieved 41% avg. top-1 accuracy for MEG (80% max).
First continuous Mandarin brain-to-text. 21% avg. WER (14% best); 93% tone decoding accuracy.
Mapped intricate semantic “atlases” tiling the cortex. Identified 4 shared dimensions and 12 distinct category clusters consistent across individuals.

Notes: NN: number of subjects; Anatomy: vSMC = Ventral Sensorimotor Cortex; vPCG = Ventral Precentral Gyrus; STG = Superior Temporal Gyrus; IFG = Inferior Frontal Gyrus; BA = Brodmann Area. Modality: ECoG = Electrocorticography; MEA = Microelectrode Array. Metrics: WER = Word Error Rate; WPM/CPM = Words/Characters Per Minute; STOI = Short-Time Objective Intelligibility. Methods: LM = Language Model; LLM = Large Language Model; SSL = Self-Supervised Learning; RNN = Recurrent Neural Network; CTC = Connectionist Temporal Classification; B2T = Brain-to-Text Benchmark.
